question: Should the Control UI assistant-message copy affordance add a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, a persisted default copy-format preference, or no core change for now?
rationale: The issue proposes two UX shapes, and the repo has a high bar for new preferences/config surfaces; automation should not choose the product behavior or plain-text conversion contract on its own.

options.title: Add a compact copy-format menu
options.body: Use the existing copy button as the anchor and let users choose Markdown or plain text per copy without adding a persisted preference surface.

options.title: Add a persisted copy-format preference
options.body: Remember the user's preferred copy format, but accept the extra settings/local-state surface and upgrade/testing burden.

options.title: Decline the core UX change
options.body: Keep the current Markdown-only copy action and ask users to use manual conversion or a future broader export/share workflow.

recommendation.title: Add a compact copy-format menu
recommendation.body: Use the existing copy button as the anchor and let users choose Markdown or plain text per copy without adding a persisted preference surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current copy-as-markdown behavior and has recent adjacent Control UI chat history, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the UX decision.
